# nb-studio label

## label create

Create a label

Needs `update` on the `pm.labels` settings item.

```bash
nb-studio label create <name>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `name`   |             |

| Flag      | Type    | Description |
| --------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--color` | gray \\ | red \\      | orange \\ | yellow \\ | green \\ | blue \\ | purple |     |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/labels` (`projectsCreateLabel`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio label create bug --color "#e5484d"
```

## label delete

Delete a label

Needs `update` on the `pm.labels` settings item.

```bash
nb-studio label delete <label>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `label`  |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this label? Issues lose it.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/labels/{labelId}` (`projectsDeleteLabel`)

## label list

List labels

```bash
nb-studio label list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `name`, `color`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/labels` (`projectsListLabels`)

## label update

Update a label

Needs `update` on the `pm.labels` settings item.

```bash
nb-studio label update <label>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `label`  |             |

| Flag      | Type    | Description |
| --------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--name`  | string  |             |
| `--color` | gray \\ | red \\      | orange \\ | yellow \\ | green \\ | blue \\ | purple |     |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/labels/{labelId}` (`projectsUpdateLabel`)
